description: This file contains a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw aggregate records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agent name and a secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'), filling missing categories with an 'unknown' label, and sorts agents and categories as specified.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw records into a grouped dataset with zero-filled categories for consistent charting. Supports grouping by 'environment' or 'cost_category' with options for labeling and sorting.
